text: The door was still open. They didn't step in.
They set the planet down at the start of the game.
Someone came through, not into the room.
The door didn't close. The bot knew the name.
A handle, a face, one line on the screen.
We watched from the desk. We didn't rewind.
If they come back later, the door will still be on our side.
The little one saw them. That's enough for today.
